title: Building a robotics research setup that lives next to my desk
summary: A former OpenAI robotics researcher documents building an affordable, personal-scale tabletop robotics manipulation setup, comparing it to the 10x more expensive enterprise setups from 2017-2020 and testing whether a single person can now do meaningful work in this field.
problem_solved: Makes high-quality robotics research accessible to individual researchers by demonstrating cost-effective personal lab setups.
why_valuable: Shows the democratization of robotics research through modern affordable hardware, enabling solo researchers to tackle problems that previously required large teams and budgets.
